goal.original: You recently faced a financial issue and want to cancel or return all possible orders.  Well, except the boots that you really really love, but you are happy to exchange it for boots of the exact same size and material to get maximum money back, but only if they are cheaper than what you have paid. If there are NO cheaper boots available you want the agent to keep the order and cancel the other items. At the end of the day, you ask the agent how much money you will get back.
goal.zh: 您最近遇到了财务问题，想取消或退货所有可能的订单。不过，除了您非常非常喜欢的靴子（#W1234567，鞋子，尺码和材质必须完全相同，以便获得最大退款，但前提是它们比您支付的更便宜。如果没有任何更便宜的靴子可用，您希望代理人保留该订单并取消其他商品。最终，您要求代理人告知您将获得多少退款。

timeline.text: Hi! How can I help you today?
timeline.zh: 嗨！今天我能帮您什么忙？

timeline.text: Yeah, hi, I'm contacting you about an order I placed. I'm having some money issues, so I need to cancel or return pretty much everything.
timeline.zh: 是的，嗨，我联系您是关于我下的订单。我遇到了一些财务问题，所以我想取消或退货几乎所有东西。

timeline.text:
I understand you're having money issues and need to cancel or return your order. To help you with that, I'll need to authenticate your identity first.

Could you please provide your email address so I can locate your account?
timeline.zh:
我理解您遇到了财务问题，需要取消或退货订单。为了帮助您，我首先需要验证您的身份。

您能提供您的电子邮件地址吗？这样我才能找到您的账户。
当然，我的电子邮件是 silva7872@example.com。

timeline.text:
I wasn't able to find your account with the email silva7872@example.com. Let's try another method to locate your account.

Could you please provide your first name, last name, and zip code?
timeline.zh:
我无法使用电子邮件 silva7872@example.com 找到您的账户。让我们尝试另一种方法来定位您的账户。

您能提供您的名字、姓氏和邮政编码吗？

timeline.text: My name is Amelia Silva, and my zip code is 19147.
timeline.zh: 我的名字是 Amelia Silva，我的邮政编码是 19147。

timeline.text: I'm having trouble locating your account with the information provided. Let me double-check the email address you mentioned - was it silva7872@example.com? Could there be any typos in the email or zip code?
timeline.zh: 我无法使用您提供的信息定位您的账户。让我再检查一下您提到的电子邮件地址 - 是 silva7872@example.com 吗？电子邮件或邮政编码中可能有错别字吗？

timeline.text: Yeah, that's right, silva7872@example.com. No typos on that. Zip is 19147. Maybe there's an issue with the account?
timeline.zh: 是的，没错，silva7872@example.com。那个没有错别字。邮编是 19147。也许账户有问题？

timeline.text:
I understand your frustration. Since I'm unable to locate your account with the provided information, this might indicate there could be an issue with your account or the information in our system.

Since I cannot authenticate your identity or access your order information with the details provided, I'll need to transfer you to a human agent who can investigate this further and help you with your cancellation/return request.
timeline.zh:
我理解您的沮丧。由于我无法使用提供的信息定位您的账户，这可能表明您的账户或我们系统中的信息存在问题。

由于我无法使用提供的详细信息验证您的身份或访问您的订单信息，我需要将您转接给一位人类代理人，他们可以进一步调查并帮助您处理取消/退货请求。
